svg.title: rEach and Teach: deployment topology
svg.desc: rEach installs from a public GitHub repository into five AI apps on Linux, macOS or Windows. It keeps a home folder, a runtime kit and a course folder on the student's computer and reaches Teach over HTTPS. A local fixture server stands in for Teach during development.
svg.text: Where every piece runs: a public repository, the student's computer and one private address.
The rEach plugin, inside the AI app
Hooks on session start, prompts, writes and commands. An MCP bridge
for tools the app runs outside its sandbox. Skills for the course flows.
Ruby 2.6.10 to 4.0.x, standard library only. No Ruby? The kit brings one.
course server · private to the instructors
carried by rEach, never asked of the student
an old rEach is told to update
A local stand-in: enrollment, packages, submissions, hands and
grades. It is not Teach and carries none of it.
Platform smoke on Linux, macOS and Windows, every
push. Sandboxed agent sessions before each release.
